name: Single-stage progression

source.description: Four inspected references keep one stage or diagram on screen and change its state step by step instead of cutting between scenes.

technique: One persistent layout (a diagram, a recipe stage, a theatre set, a 3D scene) evolves: elements are added, re-labelled, stamped, connected or lit, while a caption or step header names the change. The viewer never re-orients, so attention goes to what changed.
purpose: Explain processes and state machines; reduce cognitive load in how-tos and technical explainers.
visual_behaviour: The same stage throughout; small local changes per beat (a value updates, a card greys out, a stamp lands, a connector draws, a light comes on).
mechanics: Persistent DOM; per-step tweens on existing elements; state changes chained from the previous state for seek safety; optional progress tracker and changing caption.

decomposition.timing: A state change every 2-8 s (ref-95c96d5c47 sections of about 6 s; ref-c3bc609841 about 5 s per step); no hard cuts in two references.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: Ordered list of stage states with their cue times

failure_modes: Too many simultaneous changes per step
Stage too dense to see small changes in portrait

implementation.approach: Compose existing components on one scene: Studio.comp.stepper for position, Studio.draw.connect for relations, Studio.fx.stamp for state labels, Studio.comp.callout for attention, chained colour/text swaps. Prototype: tests/reference-derived/explainer-annotations; used in projects/paper-plane-field-notes. A dedicated composition is not justified yet.

priority.note: Directly serves the workspace's explainer pipeline.

provenance.observed: One diagram of machines and a shared element changes owner, lease bars and states across numbered steps.
A recipe stays on one stage for 30 s with no cuts; ingredients, a step card and a stepper update.
A theatre stage persists while a hanging caption sign and the set change.
One 3D scene is explored chapter by chapter with a persistent caption card.

evidence.notes: One relay stage changes state through connectors, callout, fall and stamp.
One sheet stays on one stage through four folds while the copy and tracker change beside it. Frame review 0 errors, 0 warnings (preview grade).

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown). Subjects, diagrams and copy in the prototype are original.
